go missing: Pet cats sometimes go missing for several days, so it is a good idea to put a name tag on their collar.
寵物貓有時會失蹤好幾天，所以在牠們的項圈上掛名牌是個好主意。
the missing link: Scientists believe this ancient bird fossil may be the missing link between dinosaurs and modern birds.
科學家認為這個古鳥類化石可能是恐龍和現代鳥類之間缺失的環節。
a missing person: When the hiker did not return home by Sunday night, his family reported him to the police as a missing person.
那位登山客週日晚上還沒回家時，他的家人向警方通報他為失蹤人口。
missing in action: Her grandfather was reported missing in action during the war, and his body was never found.
她的祖父在戰爭中被列為作戰失蹤，遺體始終沒有被找到。
the missing piece of the puzzle: The detective finally found the missing piece of the puzzle when a witness described the man's red jacket.
當一名目擊者描述那名男子的紅色夾克時，警探終於找到了拼圖缺的那一塊。
a mobile phone: Students are not allowed to use a mobile phone during class, so they must turn them off before the bell rings.
學生上課時不准使用手機，所以鐘響前必須把手機關機。
a mobile library: Every Friday a mobile library drives to the mountain village so that children there can borrow books.
每週五都有一輛行動圖書館開到山村，讓那裡的孩子可以借書。
upwardly mobile: Many upwardly mobile young workers move to big cities, hoping to earn more money and improve their social status.
許多向上流動的年輕上班族搬到大城市，希望賺更多錢並提升社會地位。
socially mobile: Education helps people become socially mobile, giving children from poor families a chance at a better life.
教育幫助人們變得社會流動，讓貧窮家庭的孩子有機會過更好的生活。
remain mobile: Regular walking and stretching help elderly people remain mobile, so they can move around without help.
規律散步和伸展能幫助長者保持行動自如，讓他們不需協助就能四處走動。
a mock exam: Before the real GSAT, all the seniors take a mock exam to practice managing their time.
在正式學測之前，所有高三生都會參加一次模擬考，練習時間分配。
a mock interview: Our teacher held a mock interview with each of us to help us practice for our college applications.
老師和我們每個人進行一場模擬面試，幫助我們為大學申請做練習。
mock surprise: She opened her eyes wide in mock surprise, although she had known about the birthday party all along.
她假裝驚訝地睜大眼睛，雖然她其實早就知道生日派對的事了。
a mock trial: In civics class, we held a mock trial in which students played the judge, the lawyers, and the witnesses.
在公民課上，我們舉辦了一場模擬審判，由學生扮演法官、律師和證人。
in mock horror: When I showed him my terrible drawing, my brother covered his eyes in mock horror and laughed.
當我給弟弟看我畫得很爛的圖時，他假裝驚恐地遮住眼睛，然後大笑。
moderate exercise: Doctors suggest doing thirty minutes of moderate exercise, such as fast walking or cycling, most days of the week.
醫生建議一週大多數的日子都做三十分鐘的適度運動，例如快走或騎腳踏車。
a moderate income: With a moderate income, the young couple could pay their rent but had to save carefully to buy a car.
這對年輕夫妻靠著中等收入付得起房租，但得小心存錢才能買車。
moderate views: Many voters supported her because of her moderate views, which avoided the extremes of both political sides.
許多選民支持她是因為她溫和的觀點，避開了政治兩方的極端立場。
moderate success: The new restaurant enjoyed moderate success in its first year; it was not famous, but it made a small profit.
這家新餐廳在第一年獲得了中等程度的成功；雖然不出名，但有小賺一些。
in moderation: Eating chocolate is fine in moderation, but having too much every day can hurt your teeth and health.
適度地吃巧克力沒關係，但每天吃太多會傷害你的牙齒和健康。
a moderate climate: The region has a moderate climate that is never too hot in summer or too cold in winter.
這個地區有溫和的氣候，夏天不會太熱，冬天也不會太冷。
a modest income: Although his parents lived on a modest income, they always found money to buy him books.
雖然他的父母靠著不高的收入過活，他們總是能擠出錢來幫他買書。
a modest increase: Prices rose only slightly this year, with a modest increase of about two percent.
今年物價只稍微上漲，小幅上升了大約百分之二。
a modest house: The famous writer lived in a modest house with two small bedrooms and a simple garden.
這位知名作家住在一棟樸實的房子裡，只有兩間小臥室和一座簡單的花園。
be modest about one's success: Even after winning the national prize, Amy was modest about her success and thanked her teachers instead.
即使贏得全國大獎後，艾咪仍對自己的成就謙虛，反而感謝她的老師們。
modest proposals: The committee made only modest proposals, such as adding a few more trash cans, instead of major changes.
委員會只提出了溫和的提案，例如多加幾個垃圾桶，而不是重大的改變。
a modest dress: Visitors to the temple are asked to wear a modest dress that covers their shoulders and knees.
參觀這座寺廟的遊客被要求穿著能遮住肩膀和膝蓋的端莊的衣服。
moist cake: My grandmother adds yogurt to the batter, which makes a soft, moist cake that never tastes dry.
我祖母會在麵糊裡加優格，做出鬆軟濕潤的蛋糕，吃起來從不乾。
moist eyes: With moist eyes, the old man thanked the young nurse who had cared for his wife.
老人帶著含淚的雙眼，向照顧他妻子的年輕護理師道謝。
keep the soil moist: Water the seeds every morning and keep the soil moist, but be careful not to give them too much water.
每天早上幫種子澆水並保持土壤濕潤，但小心不要澆太多水。
